description: This file defines the ConsulClusteringProviderBuilder class which implements provider builder interfaces for silo and client clustering in Orleans. It registers the provider and implements configuration methods to bind configuration sections to options.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: Implements provider setup for Orleans silo and client clustering using Consul, and registers it with annotations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures silo builder with Consul clustering options by binding the provided configuration section.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures client builder with Consul clustering options by binding the provided configuration section.
